name: ColorSwatchPicker
summary: Selects a color from a set of swatches.

useWhen: Choosing a color from a fixed set of presets
avoidWhen: Entering an arbitrary color; use ColorField
Editing a color visually; use ColorPicker

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled color strings are supported.
Arrow keys move focus between swatches without selecting one.
A press on a swatch, or Space or Enter on the focused swatch, selects it.
readOnly keeps arrow-key focus movement and blocks selection: presses, Space, and Enter do not change the value.
A read-only swatch picker does not call onChange.
Does not participate in forms and admits no name; use a named ColorField to submit a color.
A null value is controlled and empty; undefined leaves the value uncontrolled.
Each item needs a distinct color, because options are keyed by color; duplicate colors throw a TypeError.
An item's label or textValue names its swatch; otherwise the swatch uses its color name.
onChange emits the selected swatch color as a CSS string in that swatch's color space.
That is rgba(r, g, b, a) for hex or RGB swatches and hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for HSL or HSB swatches.
